title: Training Note — The Adjustment Reading on a Rebuilt Payment, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

# Training Note — The Adjustment Reading on a Rebuilt Payment, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

*Basis questions answered for the finance desk.*

**Which give-backs adjust the balance a rebuilt payment is worked out on?** Those booked inside the stretch the adjustment reading runs over, on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan read in one of three ways.

- Where a give-back has been booked to the plan in the whole month ending on the handling date, only the give-backs booked in that single whole month adjust the balance.
- Where no give-back has been booked in that month and the plan stands past due at the handling date, every give-back booked since the plan began billing adjusts the balance.
- In every other case, the give-backs booked in the term's repeat window of whole calendar months adjust the balance.

**Which reading governs on a past due plan with a give-back this month?** The first: a give-back in the month just ending narrows the reading to that month whatever the plan's standing.

**What is the repeat window?**

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repeat window, rolling whole months | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

The repeat window stands at 6 whole calendar months on every promotional term.

**Worked readings (hypothetical).** A plan carrying give-backs of 20.00 USD booked this month and 45.00 USD booked eight months ago: where the reading is the single whole month, 20.00 USD adjusts the balance. On a past due plan with no give-back this month, both the 45.00 USD and anything else booked since billing began adjust it. On an active plan with no give-back this month, only give-backs inside the 6 whole calendar months of the repeat window do, so the 45.00 USD does not.
